verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only developer/API documentation (task creation, webhooks, app components) and community commentary on UI/performance/hiring — none of it describes Asana's native initiative-tracking constructs (e.g., Goals/Portfolios) with status, priority, and owning-team fields. Mentions of 'reading status updates' (asana-docs-4, asana-docs-15) are about relaying update text via API, not about initiative status/priority/owner fields as a PM feature.
